scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings 0 src tests lint eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mts && oxlint --deny-warnings src tests vitest.config.mts && oxfmt --check src tests lint eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mts
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-contracts generate && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @codexworkbench/luming-studio-ii-contracts generate && pnpm test:lint && vitest run
scripts.build: pnpm check && vitest run && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
